verdict.line: You lose the lane if she lands a Flawless Duet mark and chains Bladesurge resets before you can answer; you win it by refusing to fight while her Q and E are up and punishing the auto that follows her engage.

brief.thesis: Irelia's Q (Bladesurge) refreshes its cooldown and heals her whenever the target is Marked or dies to it, so once her E (Flawless Duet) marks you she can chain dash-auto-dash for free sustain and Ionian Fervor stacks. Fiora's own Q (Lunge) can be thrown twice in a couple of seconds at no mana cost, which matches her mobility, and W (Riposte) parries the single follow-up auto that powers her passive stacking. The measured 53.6% Fiora win rate over 1121 games says this is winnable, not free — the lane shape itself grades even.

theirWindow.when: Flawless Duet lands and marks you
theirWindow.what: Every Bladesurge she throws at you now refreshes itself and heals her while stacking bonus attack speed toward the passive's on-hit damage payoff. Disengage past her 600-range Q or hold Riposte for the auto that follows the dash.

yourWindow.when: Both her Q and E are on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With no dash and no stun available she can't punish or escape an all-in. Lunge in, keep the second free dash in reserve for stick or reset, and pop Burst of Speed once you're in range so every landed hit builds move speed toward the kill.

start.why: Run in 94% of games at 52.5% win rate over 1262 games — the AD and sustain let you match her early auto trades without losing the lane to poke.

boots.why: 85.3% pick, 53.4% win rate over 1023 games. Irelia's damage is entirely physical — from her autos, Bladesurge, and Marked blades — so flat armor mitigates every source she has.

core.why: First item in the highest-sample, highest-win-rate path (65.4% over 280 games). The AD and sustain fund your Q-into-auto trades before she can stack Fervor.
Second item on the same 65.4% path — adds the burst and move speed that pair with Burst of Speed to close distance and stick during all-ins.
Closes out the 65.4%-win-rate core. Damage-over-time mitigation keeps you alive through her passive-stacked autos while your own healing outlasts hers.

situational.when: you need a faster burst spike to punish her before she can stack the passive in a skirmish
her Bladesurge healing is winning extended trades against you
the game goes long and you need the added scaling and wave presence
their comp adds enough CC or magic damage on top of Irelia to justify the tenacity

runes.keystoneWhy: Both meta pages run it at 50-60.9% win rate. Chaining Lunge into an auto, or hitting empowered attacks during Burst of Speed, stacks PtA's damage bonus quickly — it rewards exactly the consecutive-hit pattern Fiora wants in this matchup.

summoners.why: Run in 91.2% of games at 52.3% win rate. Ignite cuts through the healing Irelia gets from Bladesurge and secures kills once Blade Waltz or an all-in gets her low; Flash covers the gap when Lunge's 600 range isn't enough to engage or disengage.

playing.title: Track her Fervor stacks constantly
playing.detail: Ionian Fervor gives her stacking attack speed and, at max stacks, bonus on-hit damage. Back off before she's capped rather than trading into her strongest auto-attack window.

playing.title: Disengage once Marked
playing.detail: Flawless Duet's mark lets every following Bladesurge refresh itself and heal her. If you get marked, break Q range or wait the mark out instead of continuing to trade.

playing.title: All-in only when Q and E are down
playing.detail: With Bladesurge and Flawless Duet both on cooldown she has no dash and no stun. That's your window to Lunge in and commit.

playing.title: Save Riposte for her follow-up auto
playing.detail: Time W's parry for the basic attack she throws right after landing Flawless Duet or dashing in with Bladesurge — it denies the hit and reflects magic damage back at her.

playing.title: Use the double-Lunge to match her one dash
playing.detail: Q can be re-cast a second time within a couple seconds at no mana cost. Use the second dash to stick on her or reset spacing after her single Bladesurge.

playing.title: Hold Burst of Speed for the kill, not for poke
playing.detail: E's move speed gain builds with every landed attack or Lunge, and a kill fully refreshes its cooldown. Save it for committed all-ins where you can chain hits, not for early trades.

playing.title: Use Blade Waltz to confirm, not to open
playing.detail: R's successive hits on the same target deal reduced damage, so it closes out a fight she's already losing rather than starting one.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build order, runes, and summoner picks are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG. The mechanical reasoning — when to trade, when to hold W, how the mark interacts with her Q — is my own read of the ability text, not sampled data.

stats.opponentTip: Keep an eye out on Irelia’s (P) stacks when fighting her. It is ideal to block her (E) or (R) with [W].
